text: Producers rerun the full cargo test suite (9 to 11 minutes) many times: job 20261019-013309-nvbb's producer ran it six times and hit its 1800 s deadline, and the producer brief sends a report back without 'a real full cargo test --locked result' (job 20261023-165947-e7bd). Athena runs fmt, clippy and the full suite on the candidate itself after the producer, so the producer should run targeted tests while working and need not report a full-suite run; a send-back should not demand one. Keep any check that would let a failing candidate through.
